Info

Defines structural protocol IJacobianCalculator for planar arm differential kinematics.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.solver.numerical.jacobian.icalculator.IJacobianCalculator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining differential kinematics and Jacobian calculations.

It defines:

methods:
compute_jacobian - Computes 2x2 forward kinematics Jacobian matrix.
compute_damped_inverse - Computes Damped Least Squares (DLS) pseudoinverse.
compute_manipulability - Calculates Yoshikawa manipulability dexterity index.
multiply_vector - Multiplies a 2x2 Jacobian matrix by a 2D column vector.
get_version - Returns calculator component version string.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
compute_damped_inverse(theta1: float, theta2: float, damping: float) → JacobianMatrix2D[source]¶

Computes Damped Least Squares (DLS) pseudoinverse matrix J* = J^T (J J^T + lambda^2 I)^-1.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

  • damping – Levenberg-Marquardt damping factor lambda.

Returns:

Damped inverse JacobianMatrix2D mapping dx -> dtheta.

compute_jacobian(theta1: float, theta2: float) → JacobianMatrix2D[source]¶

Computes 2x2 planar Jacobian matrix J from joint angles.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

Returns:

JacobianMatrix2D instance.

compute_manipulability(theta1: float, theta2: float) → float[source]¶

Calculates the scalar Yoshikawa manipulability index w = sqrt(det(J J^T)).

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

Returns:

Scalar manipulability measure in mm^2.

get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns calculator component version string representation.

Returns:

Semantic version string.

multiply_vector(matrix: JacobianMatrix2D, dx: float, dy: float) → tuple[float, float][source]¶

Multiplies a 2x2 Jacobian matrix by a 2D column vector [dx, dy]^T.

Parameters:

  • matrix – JacobianMatrix2D instance.

  • dx – First component of vector.

  • dy – Second component of vector.

Returns:

Resulting 2D tuple (res_x, res_y).
